description: PAID ($0.009 USDC via x402). Backtest a simple, stated trading rule on a crypto asset's daily USD closes from Coinbase Exchange and compare it with buying and holding over the same window. Strategies: sma_cross (long while the fast simple moving average is above the slow one), rsi_reversion (buy below rsiBuy, sell above rsiSell), dca (buy a fixed slice every dcaEveryDays), buy_and_hold. Signals formed at one close are executed at the next (no look-ahead); a fee of feeBps per trade; long or flat only. Returns total return, buy-and-hold return, max drawdown, Sharpe, exposure, win rate, the trades and an equity curve, with the full rules in method. 30-365 days. An empty body tests BTC, SMA 20/50 over 180 days. A ticker with no Coinbase USD market is 404 (not charged). A test of past prices, not a forecast or advice. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

asset.description: Crypto asset ticker with a USD market on Coinbase Exchange (BTC, ETH, SOL, …). Default BTC

days.description: Length of the tested window in days, 30-365 (default 180)

fast.description: sma_cross: fast moving-average length in days, 2-100 (default 20)

feeBps.description: Fee on every trade in basis points, 0-100 (default 10 = 0.1%)

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

rsiBuy.description: rsi_reversion: buy when RSI falls below this, 1-50 (default 30)

rsiSell.description: rsi_reversion: sell when RSI rises above this, 50-99 (default 70)

slow.description: sma_cross: slow moving-average length in days, 3-200, longer than fast (default 50)

strategy.description: sma_cross (long while the fast moving average is above the slow one), rsi_reversion (buy when RSI falls below rsiBuy, sell when it rises above rsiSell), dca (buy a fixed amount every dcaEveryDays), buy_and_hold. Default sma_cross

name: strategy_backtest

asOf.description: ISO time the prices were read

buyAndHoldReturnPct.description: Buying at the first close and holding, in percent (no fee) — the benchmark

endPriceUsd.description: Close on the last day of the window

equityCurve.description: Up to 31 evenly spaced points of the equity curve, with the asset's close

exposurePct.description: Share of days the rule held the asset, in percent

finalEquityUsd.description: Capital at the end, cash plus the asset at the last close

market.description: The Coinbase Exchange market read, e.g. BTC-USD

maxDrawdownPct.description: The largest peak-to-trough fall of the rule's equity, in percent

method.description: The rules, in full — enough to recompute every number

note.description: What a backtest is and is not

params.description: The parameters the rule used (defaults filled in)

period.description: The tested window: first and last completed UTC day, and its length

sharpe.description: Annualised Sharpe ratio of daily equity returns (risk-free 0); null when equity never moved

startPriceUsd.description: Close on the first day of the window

strategy.description: The rule tested: sma_cross, rsi_reversion, dca or buy_and_hold

totalReturnPct.description: The rule's return over the window, fees included, in percent

tradeList.description: The last 30 trades: date, buy or sell, execution close

winRatePct.description: Share of closed round trips that ended above their entry, in percent; null with no closed trip
